forbidden_substitutes: A same-source JSON self-comparison is not cross-consumer identity evidence.
A newly generated static HTML page is not the existing Web learning surface.
claims.observable_behavior: A milestone that names an existing product consumer cannot seal review evidence that names only a substitute surface.
claims.resolution_basis: The opt-in completion gate compares each claim's exact product_entrypoints with the milestone-required entrypoints and validates independent positive and negative selectors before review sealing.

evidence.reference: The deterministic verifier must execute the exact positive selector and emit a selector-bound receipt.
The deterministic verifier must execute both exact negative selectors and emit selector-bound receipts.
The gate returns a structured claim summary retaining each evidence status, including NOT_VERIFIED.

forbidden_substitutes: A targeted test process exiting zero is not full exact-candidate verification.
A committed checkpoint identity is not silently interchangeable with the post-commit sealed HEAD and fingerprint.
claims.observable_behavior: Review request sealing accepts only read-back evidence whose repository HEAD, fingerprint algorithm/value, pre/post identity, and required completion gate all match the current candidate.
claims.resolution_basis: The existing verifier remains the single evidence producer; the review-request loader now rejects missing gate results, missing read-back, stale HEAD, fingerprint drift, and release promotion.

evidence.reference: The deterministic verifier must execute the exact matching-candidate selector and emit a selector-bound receipt.
The deterministic verifier must execute the exact missing/stale-evidence selector and emit a selector-bound receipt.
Review sealing loads the exact verifier artifact from a repository-relative path and rechecks candidate identity.
